english.notes:
(i) Section 86 specifies the conditions and requirements for the Care Quality Commission to give a penalty notice in cases of fixed penalty offences.
(ii) The Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014 (regulation 24 and Schedule 5) prescribe fixed penalty offences for the purposes of section 86, as well as the amount of the penalties and other relevant matters. Be aware that the provisions contained in these Regulations only apply in relation to regulated activities carried on in England ).
